notes.title: Blue Wednesday Prologue Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43696269/90515bcacac144a7addad18d6ccf818106395497.png[/img]

[h3]Hey everyone,

We've added new content and features to the Blue Wednesday Prologue. 
Check out the update to experience them! [/h3]


[u]Here's a list some of the changes:[/u]


[b][h2]New Features:[/h2][/b]
Added save system: separate save files.
Added the new UI system
[list]
[*] Controller selection 
[*] Customize Key Presets
[*] Vinyl Collection 
[*] Collect Sheet Music 
[*] Characters information: currently inactive. 
[/list]
Modified 
[list]
[*] Improved Rhythm game logic
[*] Improved NPC Behaviour
[*] Improved Event system 
[/list]


[b][h2]Content Update: [/h2][/b]

Added a short tutorial and improved directing.
Added side character histories and minigames. 
While enjoying the main story, you can also interact with the characters around you to gain more experience and enjoy the game. 


[i]And lots more!  Play the game to read the full list of changes! [/i]

notes.title: Blue Wednesday participating in the Storyteller Festival!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43696269/4be37b015715f41a8e6b318cab94f007529eeed5.jpg[/img]

[h3]Hello, guys!![/h3]
[h3]We're thrilled to announce that Blue Wednesday is participating in the Storytellers Festival.[/h3]
[h3]Seven Days Origin will be there too![/h3]

The Storyteller’s Festival begins at 9:00am 26/3/2023 (AEDT) or 2:00pm 25/3/2023 (PST), 
depending on your timezones.
You can meet good games and It will feature a bunch of narrative-rich games! 

We have also prepared a gameplay video to show. 
We would like to do a live broadcast later if we have time!

[h3][b]The gameplay broadcasting times are[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] 7:00 pm Sun, Mar 26, 2023 (PST)
[*] 2:00 pm Sun, Mar 26, 2023 (AEDT)
[*] 11:00 am Mon, Mar 27, 2023 (KST)
[/list]


Oh, WAIT!
Unlike the previous demo, there are stories and mini-game for sub-characters included.
You can taste the beginning of their story as well as Morris's!
We hope it will be a pleasant festival!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43696269/0ede98692d3c91bfca7ad6a0d6c6401e360e8def.gif[/img]





[h3]Don't forget to watch📺, set the alarm✨, like, and please support🙌 us![/h3]
